items.source: Else, this class will create a new instance every time the getObject() method is invoked. Subclasses are responsible for implementing the abstract createInstance() template method to actually create the object(s) to expose.
items.translation: 否则，该类将在每次调用getObject()方法时创建一个新的实例。子类负责实现抽象的createInstance()模板方法，以实际创建要暴露的对象。

items.source: If the "singleton" flag is true (the default), this class will create the object that it creates exactly once on initialization and subsequently return said singleton instance on all calls to the getObject() method.
items.translation: 如果"singleton"标志为true（默认值），该类将在初始化时仅创建一次对象，并在随后对getObject()方法的所有调用中返回该单例实例。

items.source: Invoked on initialization of this FactoryBean in case of a singleton; else, on each getObject() call.
items.translation: 在单例的情况下，在本工厂 Bean 初始化时调用；否则，在每次getObject()调用时调用。

items.source: The default implementation returns this FactoryBean's object type, provided that it is an interface, or null otherwise. The latter indicates that early singleton access is not supported by this FactoryBean. This will lead to a FactoryBeanNotInitializedException getting thrown.
items.translation: 默认实现返回该 FactoryBean 的对象类型，前提是该类型为接口；否则返回 null。后者表示该 FactoryBean 不支持提前访问单例实例。这将导致抛出 FactoryBeanNotInitializedException 异常。

items.source: Falls back to a SimpleTypeConverter when not running in a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 在非 BeanFactory 环境下运行时，回退到 SimpleTypeConverter。

items.source: Set if a singleton should be created, or a new object on each request otherwise. Default is true (a singleton).
items.translation: 设置是否应创建单例，或在其他情况下每次请求时创建新对象。默认为 `true`（单例）。

items.source: Logger available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.source: Eagerly create the singleton instance, if necessary.
items.translation: 如有必要，急切地创建单例实例。

items.source: Destroy the singleton instance, if any.
items.translation: 销毁单例实例（如果有）。

items.source: Return the BeanFactory that this bean runs in.
items.translation: 返回该 Bean 运行的 BeanFactory。

items.source: Expose the singleton instance or create a new prototype instance.
items.translation: 暴露单例实例或创建新的原型实例。

items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意：此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口的实现可以通过其 SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() 方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通 FactoryBean 实现，如果其isSingleton() 实现返回 false，则假定总是返回独立实例。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() method or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充后之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() 方法）或自定义 init-method 之前之前调用。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.

be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be
defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。
